payload.description_html: Photograph (A) and outline (B) of the skull of Huanansaurus ganzhouensis (HGM41HIII-0443) gen. et sp. nov. Abbreviations: an., angular; aofe., antorbital fenestra; ar., articular; d., dentary; emf., external mandibular fenestra; eno., external narial opening; eo., exoccipital; f., frontal; j., jugal; l., lacrimal; ltf., lower temporal fenestra; m., maxilla; mxf., maxillary fenestra; n., nasal; p., parietal; pf., prefrontal; pm., premaxilla, po., post orbital; pt., pterygoid; q., quadrate; qj., quadratojugal; sa., surangular; sq., squamosal; stf., supratemporal fenestra. Scale bar = 5 cm.
